ex.s: In the movie Mission Impossible, Tom Cruise made being a secret agent seem like the coolest job ever.
ex.t: 报名参加两周特工训练营的营员可以通过彩弹场上的策略学习和军事技能训练了解真实特工的生活。

ex.s: Campers will share their colorful ideas and imagination with each other and work together to visualize, sketch and paint with non-traditional techniques to create the coolest mural which will be displayed in public for all to see.

ex.s: First, I wanted to be a fireman, whose uniform looked so coolly.
ex.t: 首先，我想成为一名消防员，因为消防员的制服看起来太酷了。

ex.s: In southern Spain the sudden increase of greenhouses (which reflect light back to space) has changed the warming trend locally, and actually cooled the region.
ex.t: 在西班牙南部，温室（将光线反射回太空）的突然增加已经改变了当地的变暖趋势，实际上使该地区降温了。

defs.def: making you feel pleasantly cool 使人感到凉爽的；冷色的

ex.s: As any younger brother will tell you, having a big brother involves a lot of walking in someone else's shadow, especially when you have a brother who is a typical example of "cool".
ex.t: 学习永远不嫌晚

defs.def: calm; not excited, angry or emotional 冷静的；镇静的；平静的
not friendly, interested or enthusiastic 不友好的；冷淡的；冷漠的
（因时髦、漂亮且与众不同而）令人钦佩的，绝妙的，酷的
people say Cool! or That's cool to show that they approve of sth or agree to a suggestion （表示满意或赞同）妙极的，酷的

ex.s: But something about quantum computing makes it especially prone to hype, Johnson suggests, perhaps because “‘quantum’ stands for something cool you shouldn’t be able to understand.” And that brings me back to Taylor, who suggested that I read his book Q for Quantum.
ex.t: 但量子计算的某些特点使其特别容易受到炒作的影响，Johnson暗示道，也许是因为"'量子'代表着你本不该理解的酷东西。"这让我回到了Taylor身边，他建议我读他的书《Q for Quantum》。

defs.def: （强调金额之大）整整的，足足的
to become or to make sb/sth become cool or cooler （使）变凉，冷却

ex.s: This year, with an open mind and new knowledge in mind, I walked into another group interview while telling myself I was that cool senior.
ex.t: 人工智能确保人类拥有光明的未来。

ex.s: On a cool, starry night in mid-September 1870, four men relaxed before a campfire along the Firehole River in ____43____ is now northwestern Wyoming.
ex.t: 1870年9月中旬的一个凉爽星空之夜，四个人在火洞河畔的篝火旁放松休息，这里____现在是怀俄明州西北部。

ex.s: I remember showing my parents a video of Bea Johnson, sharing how cool I thought it would be to buy groceries with jars, and have so little trash!
ex.t: 我记得给父母看了比·约翰逊的视频，分享我觉得用罐子买杂货有多酷，还有垃圾多么少啊！

Keep the room cool rather than warm to avoid feeling sleepy.
ex.t: 保持房间凉爽而不是温暖以避免困倦。

ex.s: Safe meant cool.
ex.t: Safe意味着酷。

ex.s: As cool as it may be to receive a postcard written in Chinese, the concept doesn’t work if one doesn’t understand it.
ex.t: 虽然收到一张用中文写的明信片很酷但如果看不懂的话这个概念就行不通。

ex.s: He wasn't cool any more.
ex.t: 他不再酷了。

ex.s: This new start gave me an opportunity to redefine myself and discover an entirely new version of "cool".
ex.t: 泰森上了大学，所以我不得不独自在一所新学校重新开始。

ex.s: Tyson's definition of "cool".
ex.t: 我一直对化学、生物和数学很着迷，但这些兴趣不符合泰森对"酷"的定义。

ex.s: For the first time in my life, I actually felt cool.
ex.t: 在我人生中第一次，我真的感觉很酷。

ex.s: I'm a cool guy in my own way, too.
ex.t: 我也是一个以自己方式很酷的家伙。

ex.s: I'm relieved to know that "cool" has a much broader definition than what I used to think.
ex.t: 我很欣慰地知道，"酷"有着比我以前认为的更广泛的含义。

ex.s: What is your example of “cool”?
ex.t: 你心目中的"酷"是什么样的？

ex.s: Then came my tweens and teens, and mean girls and cool kids.
ex.t: 然后到了我的青春期和少年时代，出现了刻薄女孩和酷小孩。

ex.s: Enviable as the cool kids may have seemed, Dr Prinstein’s studies show unpleasant consequences.
ex.t: 尽管酷孩子们看起来令人羡慕，但普林斯坦博士的研究显示了令人不愉快的后果。

ex.s: They looked really cool.
ex.t: 所以，爸爸和我戴上新的牛仔帽，骑上马，慢慢朝山里走去。

ex.s: Keep their homes cool.
ex.t: 保持家里凉爽。

ex.s: Increasing Earth’s reflectiveness can cool the planet.
ex.t: 增加地球的反射率可以使地球降温。

ex.s: When combined with berries or slices of other fruits, frozen bananas make an excellent base for thick, cooling fruit shakes and low fat “ice cream”.
ex.t: 当与浆果或其他水果片混合时，冷冻香蕉是制作浓稠凉爽的水果奶昔和低脂"冰淇淋"的绝佳基底。

defs.def: to make sb feel cooler 使感到凉快（或凉爽）
to make sb calm, less excited or less enthusiastic 使冷静；使平静；使冷淡

ex.s: "Obviously, when your older brother is doing it, you think it's a cool thing to do," says Jonny.
ex.t: "很明显，当你哥哥在做这件事时，你觉得这是一件很酷的事情，"乔尼说。

ex.s: The Monkey King is really cool, and definitely a hero to me!
ex.t: 孙悟空真的很酷，绝对是我心目中的英雄！

ex.s: If the bite becomes hot, red and itchy, try to cool it down.
ex.t: 如果被咬的地方变热、变红、发痒，试着给它降温。

ex.s: Water has been added and the container was put in a cool, dark place.
ex.t: 已经加了水，容器被放在阴凉黑暗的地方。

ex.s: The container has been moved to a sunny, but cool place.
ex.t: 容器被移到了阳光充足但凉爽的地方。
